No dangerous operations, scripts, or executable logic are present in this file. The metadata aligns with standard AUR packaging practices and the upstream project's release structure. While the binaries themselves are not built from source (as expected for a `-bin` package), the presence of valid checksums ensures that users can verify the integrity of the downloaded binaries. There is no evidence of tampering, exfiltration, or malicious behavior in this file.
